description: Schwielowsee_gescannte_Plaene_Fachthema_Abwassernetz is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. There are georeferenced digital plans of the municipality of Schwielowsee for the wastewater pipeline network. They include the rainwater network in the districts of Caputh, Ferch and Geltow, in the streets that are owned by the municipality. Furthermore, they include the sewage network of the districts of Caputh and Geltow. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Schwielowsee _scanned _Plaene _Subject _Wastewater Network" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
